provenance.algorithm: Deterministic road-graph A*, alternate street circuits, rounded corners; paired neighbourhood street loops connected by climb/cross/descend air corridors. Seeded per-drone phase, speed and route weights.

validation.method: Every packed route segment checked against footprint prisms expanded by swept drone radius, descriptor offset sphere, GPU tolerance and margin; nominal ground and region bounds checked
validation.scope: Model-only swept obstacle clearance. Road-guided prerecorded trips, not live avoidance. Terrain, drone separation and real airspace unvalidated.
